Swampjaw.find: Summoned anywhere with Fossil Bait (spider eyes, bones and rotten flesh), easiest in a swamp. It will not summon if another boss is near.
attacks: Flies above you and drops three mines that blow up like creepers.
Dives down to bite you; hitting it first cancels the bite.

Draugr → Night Shade.find: Old Champion's Remains sleeps in the Old Champion's Graves (find with a Moonstone Compass). When it dies the Frenzied Shade comes out; that second phase is the real kill. Re-fight by using the Draugr sword on an Old Moon Altar.
attacks: Guards behind his shield, bashes and vaults at you; same-weapon spam makes him resist.
Winds back and slams the sword down in an area.
Bangs sword on shield to slow and weaken everyone near.
The Shade throws a big moonlight wave.
Flies up and crashes down in a soul explosion; splits into copies at half health.

Bellringer.find: Summoned with a Haunted Bell (gold and cobbled deepslate). Floats through walls.
attacks: Sends waves of projectiles along the ground toward you; they pass through walls.
Forms a square of projectiles above you that drops down.
Below half health rings its bell to slow everyone, then fires a long barrage.

Frostbitten Golem.find: Sleeps in the Frostbitten Temple in snowy plains, snowy taiga and ice spikes. Craft its locator eye to find it.
attacks: Its punches freeze and slow you.
Raises ice spikes out of the ground under you.

Dune Sentinel.find: Buried in the Ruined Pyramid in deserts. Craft its locator eye to find it.
attacks: A living sandstone cannon that keeps you away with ranged shots.
Cannot be knocked back at all.

Overgrown Colossus.find: Hidden in the Mossy Temple in jungles. Craft its locator eye to find it.
attacks: Heavy hits that poison you if you stay in melee.
Calls Mossy Golems to help at half and quarter health.

Skeletosaurus.find: Sleeps in a Skeletosaurus Nest in Nether soul sand valleys. Throw an Eye of Bones to find one.
attacks: Sweeps its tail to launch you; becomes a double whip below half health.
Shakes the ground with a shockwave.
A scary roar that throws you off balance.
Later in the fight it pulls you in and can lift you up.

Yeti.find: Skor the Yeti waits in its arena in frozen plains (Bosses'Rise).
attacks: Wide two-fist swing that freezes you.
Jumps high and crashes down; icicles burst from the ground.
After half health throws fast chunks of ice.

Frostmaw.find: Sleeps rarely in snowy plains and ice spikes, holding an Ice Crystal. Steal the crystal first to make the fight easier.
attacks: Swipes in front, sometimes twice; can disable shields.
Breathes a freezing whirlwind (not if you stole its crystal).
Shoots a freezing ball when you are far away.
Below about 60% health stands up and slams the ground; breaks shields.

Umvuthi.find: Sits on his throne in the Umvuthana Grove in savannas. Wearing an Umvuthana mask keeps him calm.
attacks: Calls a beam of sunfire down where you are going.
Blasts away anyone close to him.
Later fires a long tracking sun beam.
Pulls you in, then explodes in fire.
Summons followers; Cranes heal and shield him until killed.

Naga.find: Flies in packs over stony shores. Not a boss bar fight, but tough in groups.
attacks: Dodges arrows; a hit while it attacks knocks it down.

Dame Fortuna.find: Summoned with a Devil's Ante (gold, netherrack and a diamond).
attacks: Sends the same projectiles down from above.
Fangs rise from the ground following you.

Dead King.find: Sits on a throne at the end of the Catacombs deep underground (find with a Wayward Compass). Walk up to wake him.
attacks: Two quick hits or a heavy slam with a wind-up.
Summons undead minions from the floor.
In the last phase he flies and adds vexes and fire storms.

Cloud Golem.find: Cumulonimbus lives in the Cloudy Temple. Craft its locator eye to find it.
attacks: Summons big clouds above you that explode.
A blocking hit that puts your shield on cooldown.
In phase two fights with both arms and calls lightning.

Ancient Guardian.find: Sleeps in the Ancient Stronghold in dark forest and taiga (Eye of Many Ribs). Projectiles do not hurt it.
attacks: Three wide anchor swings; the last knocks your shield away.
Warned on screen; stuns you unless you block.
Grabs you if you are not blocking and pounds you into the ground.

Netherite Monstrosity.find: Sleeps in the soul fire of the Soul Forge in the Nether; wakes when you come close.
attacks: Slams both fists for a big area hit.
Spits magma bombs that leave lava.
Charges at you, breaking blocks and slowing you.
Throws the ground at you; shields can block it.
Sucks up lava to heal; enrages near the end and sets you on fire.

Rosalyne.find: Summoned with a Dusk Key (blackstone, amethyst, a diamond and an allium).
attacks: Starts sealed in stone with four Rose Spirits; kill them to break her shell. Happens again at half health.
Rises, then charges and swings her sword at you.
In the last phase swings many more times with short pauses.

Luxtructosaurus.find: Sealed inside a volcano in the Primordial Caves. Throw an Ominous Catalyst into the top of the volcano to wake it.
attacks: A flaming tail sweep that sets you on fire.
Rains tephra rocks from the sky.
Jumps great distances or smashes through blocks to reach you.

Forsaken.find: Created in the Forlorn Hollows when Underzealots perform a ritual on a Vesper.
attacks: Grabs and bites you up close.
Slams its arms down and launches you.
Swipes with an upper arm and knocks you aside.
Howls and fires sonic waves into the ground.

Returning Knight.find: Use a Lost Soul on an Old Moon Altar. Using an Essence of Eventide instead summons the harder Fallen Icon (Moonknight).
attacks: Charges his mace, then smashes your old spot; very slow but huge.
A wide swipe followed by a quicker slam.
Arm sweep that blinds and slows you.
Slams three times; the third erupts the ground around him.
Summons Remnants and Dark Sorcerers; reflects all projectiles.

Vizier.find: Use a Dark Scroll (black dye, magic fabric, totem of undying) inside a woodland mansion.
attacks: Flies through walls and lunges at you like a vex.
Floats over you and summons evoker fangs at your feet.
Sends a row of spikes, or swords if you are in the air.
Spawns Irks when hurt and heals from them; summons two invincible visages at half health.

Malkuth.find: Find his arena with an Eye of Malkuth, then right-click the boss spawner there to read his moves and summon him.
attacks: His attacks switch between fire and ice; you get weak to one type.
Jumps on the wall and fires cannons; you can fire your own cannons back.
Leaps and crushes the ground, then punches anyone thrown in the air.
Sends lines of fire or ice spikes.
Summons two giant swords that slam down.

Corpse Warlock.find: Rules the Bloody Altar in the Nether.
attacks: Summons corpses in waves and buffs them with Frenzy.
Drains his corpses to heal; kill them first.
Places spike traps on the ground in your path.
Rains crimson rays down; teleports away when you get close.

Lich.find: The Night Lich is summoned in the Lich Tower in cold biomes by putting a Soul Star in each of four altars. Soul Stars drop from zombies and skeletons and point to the tower.
attacks: Launches orbs that hit hard and break terrain.
Can slow you; flies out of melee range, so bring a bow.

Underworld Knight.find: Helvar waits in the Underworld Arena in the Nether; the boss door needs a key found in that dungeon.
attacks: Dashes across the arena to impale you.
Fast sword combos while moving forward.
Leaps up and slams down, cracking the floor.
Hit his marks to knock him down for free damage.

Super Sniffer.find: Strike any Sniffer with lightning (a Lightning Staff works) and it turns into the Super Sniffer.
attacks: Swings its fist up and throws you very high.
Slams the ground, sometimes after teleporting into the air.
In phase two fires a long beam that follows you.
Below half health fires a huge blast that wrecks the ground.

Gundalf, Circe, Merlin (Shadow Wizards).find: Use an Occult Fabric on the offering pedestal in the middle of a Chthonic Cathedral on the Nether roof. Kill Merlin and Circe close together and they merge into Archmage Gundalf.

Forgotten Guardian.find: Stands in the Catacombs of the Undergarden (in Frostfields and Forgotten Fields). Several can be in one dungeon.
attacks: Stands still until you come near, then follows you.
Hits hard up close and deflects some attacks.

Ender Guardian.find: Spawns when you approach the Altar of Void on the third floor of the Ruined Citadel in the End.
attacks: Fires bullets that make you float.
Creates a tornado that traps you and explodes.
After losing its helmet at half health, breaks the floor around it.

Ancient Remnant.find: At the bottom of the Cursed Pyramid in deserts; beat its guards first to wake it.
attacks: Roars and summons tornadoes that reverse your controls.
Drops tombstones on you like anvils.

Gauntlet.find: The Nether Gauntlet hides in a rare Gauntlet Arena in the Nether. Break one of the eye blocks on the central pillar with a pickaxe to summon it. Its loot is in a chest after the fight.
attacks: Turns into a fist and rams you; an empowered version explodes and leaves fire.
Charges up and fires a laser that chases you.
Only takes damage while its eye is open, usually after an attack.

Obsidilith.find: Put an Eye of Ender into the Obsidian Altar on the roof of the Obsidilith Arena floating in the End. An Elytra helps. Its loot is in a chest after the fight.
attacks: Teleports around the arena and deals big explosive damage.
Summons runic blocks that empower it.

Void Blossom.find: Grows in a rare lush cave near the bottom of the Overworld; Void Lilies point the way. The fight starts when you enter.
attacks: Spikes rise under your feet or burst outward in a ring.
Fires a green spore that explodes and poisons you.
Places small blossoms that heal it until you break them.

Chesed.find: Find his arena with an Eye of Chesed, then right-click the boss spawner to read his moves and summon him.
attacks: Tears blocks out of the ground and throws them.
Slams the floor, sending a shockwave and lightning.
Rolls around the arena; leaves fire in phase two.
Fires huge rays; break a crystal to become immune.
Drains his monoliths for a strike that hits everyone.

Moonknight.find: The Fallen Icon: use an Essence of Eventide (from the Frenzied Shade) on an Old Moon Altar. At half health it becomes the Harbinger of Moonlight.
attacks: On spawn weakens, slows and nauseates players near it.
A slightly faster version of the knight's mace slam.
Slams the greatsword down, cracking the ground behind you.
Five swings that each shoot a moonlight wave.
Fires a big beam that sets off explosions.

Accursed Lord.find: The Decaying King lives in the throne room of the Decaying Kingdom in the Nether. Re-fight with a Withered Demon Heart on a Blackstone Pedestal.
attacks: Slams his blade where you stood.
Pulls you in, or spins to knock you far, maybe into lava.
Floods the ground around him with lava.

Tyros (fire boss).find: Echo of Tyros: use a Cinderous Soulcaller (cinder essence, netherite scrap, echo shard) at the Cinderous Soul Rune in the Citadel in the Nether.
attacks: Casts fire magic; your own fire spells do less to him.
Summons Citadel Keepers to fight with him.

Infernal Dragon.find: Ashlord waits on top of the Dragon Tower in plains and mountains; climb past its guards.
attacks: Breathes fire that leaves burning ground.
Stomps with strong knockback, can push you off the tower.
A fast bite with long reach.

Redstone Monstrosity.find: Goety's giant golem. A hostile one is a boss; players can also build one with a big mold and an Animation Core.
attacks: Smashes both fists into the ground for a big shockwave.
Spits scatter bombs at you from range.
Opens fissures that spawn redstone cubes.

Gob, King of Gnomes.find: Use a Red Gnome Hat on the Golden Gnome Statue in a Court of Gnomes.
attacks: Spins with his sword in a circle.
Punches the floor for a shockwave.
Jumps to land on top of you.
Throws a slash that sets you on fire.
Summons evoker fangs and Royal Gnomes.

Trial Guardian.find: Put a Spire Key into the padlock at the bottom of a Trial Spire. Leaving the arena despawns it.
attacks: Covers its head, then explodes around itself.
Snaps its fingers to send a homing hex projectile.
Spins with beams shooting from both palms.
Teleports above you and slams down.
Summons helpers, more as its health drops.

Ignis.find: In the Burning Arena in the Nether (Eye of Flame). Beat the Ignited Revenants for Burning Ashes and put them on the Altar of Fire.
attacks: Heavy swings that burn and melt armor.
Rams or slams his shield, stunning you.
Leaps across the arena throwing fireballs.
Breaks the floor, dropping you into lava.

The Harbinger.find: Sleeps in the Ancient Factory underground (Eye of Mech). Give it a Nether Star to wake it.
attacks: Fires missiles and arcing howitzer shells.
Sweeps the arena with a laser; hide behind walls.
Becomes immune to arrows; EMP blocks stun it.

The Leviathan.find: Put an Abyssal Sacrifice into the Altar of Abyss in the Sunken City (Eye of Abyss). It only takes damage in water.
attacks: Grabs you with its tongue and drags you in.
Opens a black hole that pulls you and explodes.
Fires beams and portals around the arena.

Geburah.find: Find its arena with an Eye of Geburah, then right-click the boss spawner to read its moves and summon it.
attacks: Charges and fires a huge ray from its core.
Rotates constant lasers around the arena.
Bans an action (jumping, standing still, killing...); breaking the rule builds up sin.
Balance the scales by hitting bells or take a huge hit.

Nameless Guardian.find: Since EEEAB's Mobs 0.98 it no longer spawns in normal survival (only eggs or commands). It used to guard the Coreforge Ruins.
attacks: Melee hits that stop you using a shield.
Below 60% health it hits harder and ignores projectiles.
Only the glowing core inside the body takes real damage.

Realm Warden.find: The Realmwarden guards the portal in the Coreforge Ruins underground (Eye of Coreforge Ruins).
attacks: Big area hit in the middle of the room; hug the walls.
Heavy swings, elbows, stomps and wide sweeps.
Jumps back while firing a missile volley.
In phase two its hits make fire explode on you.

Relic Annihilator.find: A Relicron construct in the Coreforge Ruins underground (Eye of Coreforge Ruins).
attacks: Spinning saw blades up close; very fast on its wheels.
Its head core opens while firing missiles or lasers; hit it then.

Day Stalker.find: Throw a Chaos Orb into the sky to summon both Day Stalker and Night Prowler. The survivor enrages when one dies. She is stronger in daytime.
attacks: Drags Dawnbreaker along the ground and launches you up.
Five swings that shoot sunlight waves.
Flies high and crashes down in a huge explosion.

Night Prowler.find: Summoned together with the Day Stalker by throwing a Chaos Orb into the sky. She is stronger at night.
attacks: Hurls her scythe into the ground for an explosion.
Rings of evoker fangs spread out from her.
Sends a homing snake of black fire.
An aura that decays everyone near.
Phase two ultimate that blasts everything around with dark skulls.

The Obliterator.find: Insert an Eye Crystal into the Teleport Machine in the Space Station in the End highlands, midlands or small islands.
attacks: Teleports and chains attacks; bait a move, hit, then reset.

Apostle.find: Summoned by the Sabbath Ritual at a Goety dark altar (ritual in the Nether for the strongest drops).
attacks: Shoots arrows, faster as its health drops.
Summons monoliths that protect it and call servants.
Heals to full, brings a storm, meteors and lightning traps.

Ferrous Wroughtnaut.find: Stands in the Wrought Chamber, an underground room found in almost every biome.
attacks: Huge axe swing that breaks shields; chains into double and triple swings later.
Gets its axe stuck; the only time you can hit it, from behind.
Stomps to throw blocks up; jump to dodge.

Maledictus.find: Bottom chamber of the Frosted Prison in snowy biomes. Beat the Aptrgangr for the Strange Key, open the Door of Seal and right-click the Cursed Tombstone.
attacks: Wrist rings show the attack: green can be blocked, orange breaks shields, red must be dodged.
Halberd dash that hits many times.
Rains spectral halberds over a wide area.
Shoots you when you stay at range.

Scylla.find: At the top of the Acropolis in deep oceans (Eye of Storm). Right-click the giant anchor to summon her.
attacks: Swings and throws her anchor to pull you in.
Sends waves that make you Wet; wet players take more shock damage.
Throws lightning spears that ignore armor.
Later summons storm spears and magic serpents.

Immortal.find: The Immortal is still unfinished in EEEAB's Mobs; it leads the Immortal Legion sealed in the Void Crack.
attacks: Adapts to damage types you repeat; switch types.
Has two health bars and resets adaptation between them.

Chaos Monarch.find: Use a Shard of Uncertainty (dropped by the Wither) on a Blackstone Pedestal.
attacks: Staff combo of swipe, thrust and smash.
Skulls with random effects, explosions or mobs.
Turns grass to withered grass that decays you and heals it.

The Nightwarden.find: Found only in the Void Cathedral, a rare structure in the End.
attacks: Three phases with a dozen telegraphed spell and melee patterns.
Resists damage you repeat; vary your attacks.

Virtue.find: Throw an Unholy Lance into the sky anywhere in the Overworld. Stays very high in the air, so bring guns or bows.
attacks: Creates pillars of light that hurt over time.
Its pillars make you take more damage.

Ultra Sniffer.find: In the Super Sniffer's second phase, strike it with lightning again while it is under 10% health.
attacks: Fires a long beam that follows you.
Throws you very high and slams the ground.
In phase two warps around leaving traces that become strikes.
Below half health fires a faster, longer super beam.

Lord Pumpkinhead.find: Use a Transmuting Elixir on an Infernal Evil Pumpkin.
attacks: Mounted hits that cause Soul Stratification and Infernal Flame; later Living Bomb.
Teleports, leaving Senior Pumpkins or pumpkin bombs behind.
Dismounts and shoots; his horse fights up close.
In the last stage his head shoots while his body fights.
